verdict: ROAS dropped sharply; eleven days without a purchase signals creative fatigue.
narrative: This period, your Meta ads returned $3.60 for every $1.00 spent — down 60% from the prior week — while spend held essentially flat at roughly $54 per day. The core issue is confirmed: zero purchases were recorded across the last eleven days, meaning ad dollars have continued flowing with no revenue return. The most likely driver is creative fatigue, with Instagram reach also falling nearly 20% week-over-week as the current ad content loses its pull on the audience. Ad creative is being refreshed now, and the funnel test closes August 31, which will give a cleaner read on what is actually converting.
